title: Open-Ground Luxury Marquee Vision

contentHtml:

title: Sacred Mandap Stage & Family Wings
subtitle: 40ft Wide Stage • 3ft Height • 30ft Flanking Wings for Close-Family Sofa Seating
contentHtml:
40ft Centered Sacred Mandap

Elevated 3ft timber platform with 12ft sacred lotus canopy dome. Central square havan altar with copper kund, 2mm zinc safety plate, and concealed smoke extraction hood.

30ft Family & VIP Flanking Wings

30ft open space on either side of the Mandap reserved for comfortable velvet sofa seating for immediate family and elders, ensuring unobstructed ceremony views and uncluttered camera framing.

title: Sangeet Entertainment Stage & Guest Flow
subtitle: 24ft × 16ft Stage • Opposite Side of Entrance • Natural Progressive Spatial Journey
contentHtml:
24ft × 16ft Performance Stage

Positioned on the far end opposite the entrance, featuring P3 high-refresh LED backdrop, 3200K flicker-free warm cinema lighting, and glossy reflective dance floor for performances.

Intuitive Flow & Acoustic Separation

Natural progression: 100ft Road Tunnel → Foyer & Lounge → Mandap / 80-Seat Bay → 35ft Concourse → Dining → Sangeet Zone.

title: 20×8ft Central Island & Dual Main Buffet
subtitle: Multi-Sided Servicing • 70ft South Baseline • West Cocktail Grazing Lounge
contentHtml:
20×8ft Rectangular Central Island

Freestanding multi-service island with 15ft walkways on all sides for salads, chaats, breads, and plates. Eliminates queue bottlenecks by 60%.

70ft Dual Main Buffet & West Lounge

Dual parallel lines backed by BOH kitchen hub. West wall hosts cocktail cruiser tables with live tandoor starters for finger-food grazing.

title: Smart Multi-Event Reuse & Commercial Model
subtitle: Post-Wedding Outdoor Mandap Repurposing • 4-Tier Commercial Framework
contentHtml:
Post-Wedding Mandap Outdoor Reuse

After the ceremony, Mandap structure and floral backdrop are repurposed to an adjacent outdoor photo area for post-wedding couple portraits, avoiding duplicate teardown and new booth expenses.

Turnkey 30-50-20 Disbursement

Tier A (Base Shell 60%) + Tier B (Event Accents 30%) + Tier C (Special Additions 10%). Prompt milestone payments (30% token, 50% handover, 20% post-event sign-off).
